Design Lamp (LED Lamp Kit-001)

 

This is a harmonic LED Lamp in a form of a pipe.

 

Good to know before printing

* Important: Use my print profile! It is highly adapted for this print to work.

* If you have problems with overhangs, use a 0.6mm nozzle with 0.18mm layer height. You could also lower the nozzle temp by 5-10 degrees Celsius, but try a bigger nozzle first.

* I used Bambu Lab PLA Matte, Ivory White and Desert Tan
* Buy the LED Lamp Kit-001
Boost MeThanks for the support!MembershipJoin my membership for commercial license

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: Special print profile
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#E8DBB7), PLA (#FFFFFF)
